sources.title: Product - M-VAVE
sources.excerpt: M-VAVE's official product page identifies Overdrive Blues by name as one of the company's products. The page is a manufacturer source for the exact model, while the maker's broader product ecosystem places Overdrive Blues within the CUVAVE/M-VAVE effect-pedal lineup.
